_prior_art: PRIOR ART: scripts/eval/results/page-boundary-drift-leak-2026-09-24.json — the #5021 hand-read of drift/leak flags; different detectors, same one-flag-per-book discipline
_about: Hand-read precision for scripts/lib/page-integrity.mjs (2026-09-24). One flag per book, drawn by seeded shuffle from the walk output. 'final' reads were made on the final detector code with a fresh seed and books not used in tuning; 'tuning' reads found the false-positive shapes that were then fixed, and are kept as provenance. label: real | false | unclear. read_from: ocr-text (OCR + translation text read side by side) | image-pixels (grayscale correlation of the two page images, flagged pair vs an ordinary neighbour) | image-eye (both images opened and compared by eye).

final.read_from: 17 image-pixels (flagged pair r=0.967-1.000 vs neighbour r=-0.25-0.75) + 3 image-eye

final.note: real = 4 missing pages (text breaks mid-sentence across the gap) + 5 duplicate scans the duplicate check missed (a noisier second OCR, or the copy's neighbour absent from the mirror). False = printer misnumbering with continuous text, dual numbering (emblem books), manuscript foliation, OCR misreads at a book's edge.

the one real case is a duplicate scan (Boehme, Mysterium magnum pp.693/695). The model's catchword field is unreliable as evidence on its own: it tags words from the page's last line, invents catchwords for modern books, and breaks on bilingual column layouts.

tuning.note: dominant shape: the model records the page's own last word ('Doth', 'But', 'You') as the catchword — fixed by the last-word-of-page rule

final.note: unclear = the translation renders the text but not the editor's notes / apparatus / footnotes (Latin variorum notes, Loeb and SBE footnotes). Whether untranslated notes are a defect is a policy question.

tuning.note: false:   padding, image-description OCR, garbage OCR, untagged bilingual
false: table markup, LaTeX, HTML-encoded Greek, [unclear] placeholders, leaked model reasoning as OCR — fixed by measuring reading length (letters+digits) and unjudging reasoning leaks

final.note: false: letter/symbol tables, place-name lists, transliteration, diplomatic papyrus transcriptions — copying is correct there
mostly legitimate quotations kept in the original (Latin inside German, Greek inside French), citation lists, and English already in the source. Not a defect class.
